Na__Hotkeys__Description: Global view-mode hotkeys for TrueVision3D. Single source of truth for all hotkey bindings. Changes here automatically propagate to the hotkey manager, toolbar tooltips, navigation help panel, and user instructions overlay.

Na__Hotkeys__ViewModes.Na__Hotkeys__ViewMode__Description: Number keys 0-3. No modifier keys required. Keys are ignored when an input field has focus or when Ctrl/Meta/Alt is held.

Na__Hotkeys__Display__Labels.Na__Hotkeys__Display__Labels__Descriptio: Human-readable action names used in help panels, tooltips, and the user instructions overlay.

Na__Hotkeys__Movement__Reference.Na__Hotkeys__Movement__Reference__Descri: Movement keys used within each navigation mode. Managed by the individual mode modules (Na__DefaultNavmode__MouseControls, Na__Navmode__WalkMode__DesktopControls, Na__Navmode__FlyMode__DesktopControls). Listed here for documentation only.

Na__Hotkeys__Ui__Reference.Na__Hotkeys__Ui__Reference__Description: Context-sensitive UI keys. Handled by their respective UI modules. Listed here for documentation only.
